    needs: [packaged-scope, packaged-smoke]
    if: always() && !cancelled()
    name: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' && !github.event.changes.base && (github.event.changes.title || github.event.changes.body) && 'metadata packaged gate' || 'packaged full gate' }}
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
      - name: Require selected packaging verification
        if: needs.packaged-scope.outputs.scope != 'full' || needs.packaged-scope.outputs.run != 'false'
        env:
          PACKAGED_SCOPE: ${{ needs.packaged-scope.outputs.scope }}
          SCOPE_RESULT: ${{ needs.packaged-scope.result }}
          PACKAGED_RESULT: ${{ needs.packaged-smoke.result }}
          PACKAGED_RUN: ${{ needs.packaged-scope.outputs.run }}
        run: node scripts/ci/packaged-ci-cli.mts gate
      - name: Preserve existing code checks after metadata edits
        if: needs.packaged-scope.outputs.scope == 'full' && needs.packaged-scope.outputs.run == 'false'
        run: echo 'Title/body edit only. Existing packaged code checks are unchanged.'
